blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – second round MANILA, Philippines—Ateneo protected its home court with a 75-72 win over Far Eastern University in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament at Blue Eagle Gym on Saturday. Jared Bahay, who finished with 15 points, four assists, two rebounds and a steal in 26 minutes, credited the Katipunan crowd for helping the Blue Eagles secure the win and keep the Tamaraws reeling. “Ever since we lost here last year, all we’ve been thinking about was, we can’t lose here again,” Bahay said, referring to last season’s triple overtime defeat to University of […]...
